# Canonical fields (schema 0.1.0)

Every entity and field of the canonical data model. **Key** marks the record identity; **Export** marks fields the register of information requires (missing ones make controls `not_assessed`), **Conditional** those that may legitimately not apply; **Sensitive** fields are encrypted at rest when a key is configured and never appear in Profile B reports. The register references are indicative (pending legal review).
